categories.main_business_segments: JCET Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in semiconductor chip finished product manufacturing and testing, offering comprehensive one-stop services including packaging design, solder bumping, probing, assembly, testing, and distribution. The company focuses on advanced packaging technologies serving applications in communications, consumer electronics, high-performance computing, automotive electronics, big data storage, AI, IoT, and industrial manufacturing. It has multiple subsidiaries and production bases in China, Korea, and Singapore.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced semiconductor packaging technologies such as wafer-level packaging (WLP), 2.5D/3D integration, system-in-package (SiP), flip chip, embedded wafer-level ball grid array (eWLB), and high-density fan-out (XDFOI®) packaging. It also employs mixed-signal/RF IC testing and advanced thermal management techniques for power modules. The production methods include high integration, multi-chip modules, and customized packaging solutions for high-performance and automotive applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: JCET serves global semiconductor manufacturers, fabless companies, and foundries, with customers spanning major regions including the Americas, China, Korea, and other Asia-Pacific countries. Its end markets include telecommunications, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, industrial and medical electronics, high-performance computing, AI, and IoT sectors. The company maintains a diversified and stable customer base with many market leaders.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major production and R&D centers in China (Jiangyin, Chuzhou, Suqian), South Korea, Singapore, and sales offices in the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. Approximately 41.64% of its assets are overseas, and significant revenue is generated from the US, China, Korea, and other countries. It has six major integrated circuit finished product manufacturing bases worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: JCET operates in the midstream to downstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in chip finished product manufacturing and testing. It receives wafers from foundries and fabless design companies and provides packaging, testing, and assembly services before the chips are delivered to electronic device assemblers and end-product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company strategically focuses on innovation in high-performance advanced packaging technologies, including 2.5D/3D integration, RF SiP/AiP, automotive electronics, and power modules. It invests heavily in R&D to develop differentiated packaging solutions for emerging markets such as AI, 5G, automotive, and high-performance computing. JCET also emphasizes lean manufacturing, cost reduction, supply chain optimization, and talent development to sustain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: JCET generates revenue primarily through product sales of semiconductor packaging and testing services based on customer orders. It provides customized, end-to-end semiconductor chip finished product manufacturing solutions, including packaging design, assembly, testing, and logistics. The company also earns income from leasing assets and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: JCET is ranked third globally among outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) providers and is the largest in mainland China. It competes with other major OSAT companies primarily from Taiwan, the US, and China. The company holds a leading position in brand recognition, technology capability, production scale, and international operations within the advanced packaging industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, JCET reported revenues of approximately RMB 29.66 billion, a 12.15% decrease from 2022, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.47 billion, down 54.48%. Despite the downturn, the company maintained positive free cash flow for four consecutive years and showed sequential quarterly performance improvement. Total assets reached RMB 42.58 billion with an 8.05% increase year-over-year, reflecting a large-scale enterprise with ongoing investment in capacity and technology.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JCET emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop semiconductor packaging and testing solutions with advanced, high-density, and customized packaging technologies that meet the evolving needs of high-growth markets such as automotive electronics, 5G, AI, and high-performance computing. Its global multi-site manufacturing and R&D footprint, strong patent portfolio, and close collaboration with leading customers provide differentiated technical capabilities and reliable quality assurance, enabling it to deliver high-value, innovative packaging solutions.
